scenes.title: Evidence before decisions
scenes.speech: RoleLens turns resumes into traceable role-alignment reports. Its Python engine uses regular expressions, with recruiters responsible for decisions.

scenes.title: Upload a job description
scenes.speech: Start with a job description. Upload a text-based P D F, Word document or text file, then select Extract J D fields.

scenes.title: Inspect the draft and its source
scenes.speech: Review the extracted title, known skills, alternatives and experience target. Source lines explain the draft. Warnings identify defaults and information needing manual review.

scenes.title: An editable rubric, before scoring
scenes.speech: Apply the draft to the role. Adjust priorities and weights. Java OR Python accepts either language, awarding its group credit once.

scenes.title: Choose a supported resume file
scenes.speech: Next, upload the fictional resume. File selection clears pasted resume text. Choose Analyze role alignment to run the shared Python engine.

scenes.title: Review the documented match
scenes.speech: This trainee example earns seventy-eight point three three. With no experience minimum, points come entirely from skills. The score measures rubric alignment.

scenes.title: Read the text behind each point
scenes.speech: Each requirement shows source lines, status and points. Action evidence earns full credit. Mentions and learning earn partial credit; unsupported skills earn zero.

scenes.title: A separate example: overlapping jobs
scenes.speech: In the backend sample, overlapping jobs count once, producing forty-eight months. Claimed years remain separate. Names and contact details never increase the score.

scenes.title: Required evidence changes the next step
scenes.speech: Now require Kubernetes and rerun that sample. Despite ninety-five points, the recommendation flags the required learning-stage gap and requests clarification.

scenes.title: Download, validate and reopen
scenes.speech: Export J S O N, C S V and printable H T M L. Reopen J S O N to validate score consistency and restore its original rubric and date.

scenes.title: Clear errors, usable controls
scenes.speech: An invalid P D F produces a clear error. Controls remain usable. Reloading the sample and analyzing again restores a valid result.

scenes.title: Real JSON files on disk
scenes.speech: The offline command line uses the same engine. This verified run saved a J S O N file and reopened the identical report.

scenes.title: Checks against the current source
scenes.speech: Verification passes one hundred and fifty-two Python tests, ten interface tests and twelve synthetic parsing cases. Linux checks also verify the container.

scenes.title: Clearer evidence. Accountable decisions.
scenes.speech: RoleLens combines J D drafting, evidence-linked matching and portable reports. Claims need verification. Scanned documents need external text recognition. The recruiter makes the decision.
